title: JetBrains Air — Agentic Development Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Agentic Dev Environment · Fleet Orchestration · Cloud Agents · Automations

rows.label: What is Air
rows.value: Agentic Development Environment — delegate coding tasks to AI agents & stay in control

rows.label: macOS install
rows.value: Download from air.dev

rows.label: Linux install
rows.value: Via JetBrains Toolbox

rows.label: Windows
rows.value: Support planned for 2026

rows.label: First launch
rows.value: Connect at least one AI provider before running tasks

rows.label: Open project
rows.value: File | Open for local; Git | Clone for remote repos

rows.label: Trust prompt
rows.value: Click Trust only for projects you own; use Preview to browse safely

rows.label: Requires
rows.value: Git (required); Docker Desktop (optional, for container runs)

rows.label: Entry point
rows.value: Chat tool — describe goal, add context, press ↩ Enter or Send

rows.label: State goal clearly
rows.value: Explain what done means, list constraints & known errors

rows.label: Add context
rows.value: Type @ or click Add context; attach files, folders, symbols, terminals

rows.label: Voice input
rows.value: Click microphone; uses local Whisper model — no audio sent to cloud

rows.label: Send task
rows.value: ↩ Enter or click Send

rows.label: Follow-up
rows.value: Send additional messages in same chat to refine the result

rows.label: Parallel tasks
rows.value: Click New Task or press ⌘⇧N to run tasks simultaneously

rows.label: Task states
rows.value: Running, Input required, Suspended, Completed

rows.label: Local Workspace
rows.value: Runs on your machine; fastest startup; changes apply directly to working copy

rows.label: Git Worktree
rows.value: Separate branch & working copy; isolates from main; still on your machine

rows.label: Docker
rows.value: Isolated container; requires Docker Desktop; complete filesystem isolation

rows.label: Cloud
rows.value: Remote environment; auto-commits result to task branch & pushes to remote

rows.label: Select env
rows.value: Click the environment name in the task header before sending

rows.label: worktree.json
rows.value: Configure env vars & setup in .air/worktree.json

rows.label: docker.json
rows.value: Configure image, user, env vars, setup commands in .air/docker.json

rows.label: Cloud lifetime
rows.value: Cloud environment available up to 24 h after task starts; then deleted

rows.label: Permission: Plan
rows.value: Agent creates .air/plans/ Markdown plan; you approve before implementation

rows.label: Permission: Ask
rows.value: Agent asks approval before each file edit or command run

rows.label: Permission: Edit
rows.value: Agent edits files automatically with moderate limits

rows.label: Permission: Full
rows.value: Fewest restrictions; use only when you trust the project fully

rows.label: Cycle modes
rows.value: Press Shift+Tab to cycle permission modes in the task toolbar

rows.label: Effort level
rows.value: Set Low / Medium / High / Max reasoning depth in the task toolbar

rows.label: Input required
rows.value: Task pauses; switch to it via View | Tasks or click notification

rows.label: Resume task
rows.value: View | Tasks → select Suspended task → click Resume

rows.label: Open diff
rows.value: After task finishes, click Changes in Chat → opens Task Changes tab

rows.label: Diff modes
rows.value: Switch between Unified and Side-by-side views in the diff header

rows.label: Comment line
rows.value: Select line in diff → click + gutter icon → type feedback → Add Comment

rows.label: Send comments
rows.value: Collect comments → click Send Comments → agent uses them as follow-up

rows.label: Add to task
rows.value: Select code in diff → click Add to Task → attach as follow-up context

rows.label: Agent review
rows.value: Click Review with Agent button after task finishes for automated review pass

rows.label: Slash review
rows.value: Type / → Review with Agent → choose scope (task, local, files, branch)

rows.label: Review model
rows.value: Settings | Global | AI | Review → set a dedicated review model

rows.label: Branch naming
rows.value: Air creates air/<task> branch; local copy stays on original branch

rows.label: Cache path
rows.value: ~/Library/Caches/JetBrains/Air/tasks/air/<task>/ (macOS)

rows.label: Apply Locally
rows.value: Copies uncommitted changes from task worktree back to local working copy

rows.label: Checkout Branch
rows.value: Apply Locally dropdown → Checkout Branch Locally → creates air/task-copy

rows.label: Revert file
rows.value: View | Changes → Task Changes tab → Revert next to file name

rows.label: Revert all
rows.value: Task Changes tab → click Revert All

rows.label: Roll back
rows.value: History tool → right-click commit → Reset Current Branch To Here

rows.label: Reset modes
rows.value: Mixed (keep all), Keep (uncommitted only), Hard (discard all)

rows.label: Tasks tool
rows.value: View | Tasks or ⌘1 — lists all tasks with status & progress

rows.label: New task
rows.value: ⌘⇧N or New Task icon in Tasks tool

rows.label: Group tasks
rows.value: Tasks settings icon → group by Date, Status, or Target

rows.label: Plan files
rows.value: Plan mode writes plan to .air/plans/ as Markdown

rows.label: Implement dialog
rows.value: After planning, choose agent, model & environment before implementation starts

rows.label: Commit message
rows.value: Click Generate Commit Message icon in Changes tool for AI-drafted message

rows.label: Stage files
rows.value: Changes tool → select file checkboxes → only staged changes go into commit

rows.label: History
rows.value: View | Tools | History — shows Git commits + Before Request snapshots

rows.label: Enable MCP
rows.value: Settings | AI | MCP Servers → toggle Enable MCP support

rows.label: Add global MCP
rows.value: Click Add Global MCP Server → paste JSON config & save

rows.label: Local MCP
rows.value: Stored in .air/mcp.json in project root — project-specific

rows.label: Workspace MCP
rows.value: Uses standard .mcp.json in project root; enable Launch workspace MCP servers

rows.label: OAuth MCP
rows.value: Server appears with Connect button; click to authorize via provider

rows.label: Bearer token
rows.value: Provide token directly in mcp.json headers.Authorization field

rows.label: Example
rows.value: { "mcpServers": { "youtrack": { "url": "https://…/mcp" } } }

rows.label: Context type
rows.value: Type @ in chat → MCP tools appear as context options when connected

rows.label: Claude Agent
rows.value: Anthropic Console (API Billing); Claude Pro/Max/Team not permitted by ToS

rows.label: OpenAI Codex
rows.value: ChatGPT (Plus/Pro/Team) or OpenAI Platform (API billing)

rows.label: Gemini CLI
rows.value: Google Account (Personal/Workspace) or Google AI Studio (API Billing)

rows.label: Junie
rows.value: JetBrains Account with AI Pro or AI Ultimate subscription

rows.label: JetBrains AI
rows.value: Universal provider — all 4 agents under one subscription via AI credits

rows.label: Select model
rows.value: Click model selector in task toolbar (e.g., Sonnet 4.5) → choose agent & model

rows.label: Switch model
rows.value: Can change model mid-task; cannot change agent provider after task starts

rows.label: Add provider
rows.value: Settings | Account | AI Providers → click Connect

rows.label: Web UI
rows.value: Run tasks at air.jetbrains.cloud without installing the desktop app

rows.label: From IDE
rows.value: Use JetBrains Cloud agent in AI Assistant in IntelliJ-based IDEs

rows.label: Result push
rows.value: Agent commits to air/<task> branch & pushes to remote automatically

rows.label: Apply cloud
rows.value: After review, create a pull request from the pushed task branch

rows.label: VM: Small
rows.value: 2 CPUs / 8 GB RAM / 20 GB disk

rows.label: VM: Medium
rows.value: 4 CPUs / 16 GB RAM / 30 GB disk

rows.label: VM: Large
rows.value: 8 CPUs / 32 GB RAM / 50 GB disk

rows.label: VM: XL
rows.value: 16 CPUs / 64 GB RAM / 100 GB disk

rows.label: Startup script
rows.value: Add .air/cloud/startup.sh; runs after clone, before agent; must be idempotent

rows.label: Connect repos
rows.value: air.jetbrains.cloud | Settings | Integrations → click Connect for provider

rows.label: Providers
rows.value: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket — via JetBrains Air app installation

rows.label: Org repos
rows.value: Admin must install JetBrains Air app for the org before repos appear

rows.label: Push shortcut
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃P — push local changes to remote tracked branch

rows.label: Pull shortcut
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃U — pull remote changes into current branch

rows.label: Git Blame
rows.value: ⌃G ⌃A — toggle blame gutter showing author per line

rows.label: Amend commit
rows.value: Git tool → settings icon → Amend Commit to modify latest commit

rows.label: Branches menu
rows.value: Click branch name in toolbar → create, checkout, push, fetch, delete branches

rows.label: Manage
rows.value: Web UI → air.jetbrains.cloud | Automations page

rows.label: Triggers
rows.value: Schedule (At time), Repeat every (interval), GitHub events, Webhook

rows.label: GH events
rows.value: PR Opened/Updated/Merged/Review requested/Labeled; Issue Opened/Labeled

rows.label: Webhook trigger
rows.value: POST to auto-generated URL; include Authorization: ApiKey <token>

rows.label: Notifications
rows.value: Add outgoing webhook; Air sends POST on run success/failure

rows.label: Slack format
rows.value: Use hooks.slack.com/triggers/… URL for flattened Slack workflow payload

rows.label: Privacy
rows.value: Private = owner only; Organization = visible to org, editable by owner only

rows.label: Templates
rows.value: Click predefined template on New Automation page to pre-fill prompt

rows.label: Slash menu
rows.value: Type / in task input to open commands & skills list

rows.label: Review cmd
rows.value: / → Review with Agent → choose scope

rows.label: Upload file
rows.value: / → Upload File from Computer

rows.label: Claude cmds
rows.value: Custom commands in .claude/commands/<name>.md

rows.label: Gemini cmds
rows.value: Custom commands in .gemini/commands/<name>.toml

rows.label: Junie cmds
rows.value: Custom commands in .junie/commands/<name>.md

rows.label: Shared skills
rows.value: Reusable workflow modules in .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md

rows.label: Agent skills
rows.value: Per-agent overrides in .claude/skills/, .codex/skills/, etc.

rows.label: CLAUDE.md
rows.value: Project instructions for Claude Agent; checked into version control

rows.label: AGENTS.md
rows.value: General agent guidance & reusable instructions for all agents

rows.label: settings.json
rows.value: Claude shared settings in .claude/settings.json; personal in .claude/settings.local.json

rows.label: Review prompt
rows.value: Global or per-project in .air/review/review-prompt.md

rows.label: Air dir
rows.value: .air/ directory in project root — commit to share config with team

rows.label: Init cmd
rows.value: Agent-specific /init command initializes project instruction files

rows.label: Docs context
rows.value: Settings | <Project> | Documentation → attach external API references

rows.label: Scope
rows.value: Global settings apply to all workspaces; project tab settings apply to current only

rows.label: Go to All
rows.value: ⌘K or Shift Shift — search files, symbols, actions, tools

rows.label: Run action
rows.value: ⌘⇧K — open Actions tab & run any IDE action by name

rows.label: Text search
rows.value: ⌘⇧F — full-text search across project with regex support

rows.label: Find usages
rows.value: ⌘U — find all usages of symbol at caret

rows.label: Go to def
rows.value: ⌘B — jump to definition of symbol at caret

rows.label: Go to impl
rows.value: ⌘⌥B — navigate to implementations of interface/abstract symbol

rows.label: Next problem
rows.value: ⌘E / ⌘⇧E — jump to next / previous problem in file

rows.label: Symbols tool
rows.value: View | Tools | Symbols — browse types, fields, functions in current file

rows.label: Fan out work
rows.value: Run independent tasks in parallel using multiple agents & Git Worktrees

rows.label: Bound scope
rows.value: Keep each task small & verifiable — one clear goal per task

rows.label: Context first
rows.value: Attach relevant files & symbols upfront; avoid over-loading entire repo

rows.label: Plan for complex
rows.value: Use Plan mode for multi-file or constraint-heavy changes before coding starts

rows.label: Keep approvals
rows.value: Leave Ask mode on for sensitive actions; only use Full Access when you trust the project

rows.label: Steer, don't fire
rows.value: Review & send comments back to agent rather than accepting everything blindly

rows.label: Idempotent scripts
rows.value: Make startup.sh & worktree.json setup scripts safe to run repeatedly

rows.label: Docs updated
rows.value: Cheat sheet built from Air docs as of 2026-07-01
